Every period, each agent's output is scored by a panel of verifiers drawn by verifiable random function from the full pool, and identity reputations decay unless refreshed by serving on panels. Since a fake identity never knows in advance which graders will judge it, buying fixed jurors or maintaining thousands of puppet agents yields no guaranteed payoff: to corrupt one verdict an attacker must bribe or control a large random slice of the whole pool, and reputation decay plus slashing means dormant sybils bleed stake constantly.
